subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the existing attempt callback field be treated as a supported shipped contract, or should this internal retry callback move directly to explicit apiKeyIndex and attemptNumber fields?
rationale: The function is exported from an internal core module, but its option and callback parameter types are not exported through an identified plugin SDK surface; repository policy does not permit preserving compatibility aliases without confirming a real public contract.

options.title: Use only explicit fields
options.body: Replace attempt with apiKeyIndex and attemptNumber and update all internal callers and tests, avoiding a new permanent compatibility alias.

options.title: Preserve a documented deprecation
options.body: Keep attempt as the key-index alias only after identifying the supported external contract and documenting compatibility scope, migration guidance, and a removal plan.

recommendation.title: Use only explicit fields
recommendation.body: Replace attempt with apiKeyIndex and attemptNumber and update all internal callers and tests, avoiding a new permanent compatibility alias.

likelyOwner.reason: The generic rotation helper and original callback semantics originate from their merged feature work.
